descriptions.w3d_d28g_hud_input_state_step_8006551c: Per-frame step of a four-stage state machine: restamps when the resource at +92 is active with a kind other than 10, sets the flag at +116 when the time argument passes the +96 value plus +120, resets to state 0 when either handle at +100 or +104 reports nonzero, then advances the state at +108 by its step callback.
